scope: Four presentation representative inputs plus optional two strict-SS seeds; read-only re-audit, no simulation.

units.actual_ssd_read: MiB=2^20 bytes, summed across SSUs per layer

metric_definitions.U1: sum compute busy in [1000,2000] ms / (32*1000 ms)
metric_definitions.U2: sum compute busy in [2000,3000] ms / (32*1000 ms)
metric_definitions.cohort_compute_fraction: sum own compute / sum(completion-admission), same full request cohort
metric_definitions.makespan: last completed request over complete frozen population, ms
metric_definitions.request_share: profile request count / full request count
metric_definitions.compute_time_share: profile complete pure compute / complete pure compute of all profiles
metric_definitions.hottest_ssu_mean_rho: max_s sum_n (total read GiB from SSD s for original NPU n / original NPU n total compute seconds) /40
metric_definitions.largest_link_mean_rho: max_n (total read GiB for original NPU n / original NPU n total compute seconds) /50

comparability_notes: 8盘E72与6盘E80的每卡配额和完整请求人口不同，不能把它们的U差异解释为只改变盘数。
6盘E80与8盘aligned_short080_seed7的请求非placement字段/顺序精确相同，只改变拓扑及placement；后者不是本次8盘E72代表组。
8盘V38与6盘raw_size_varied画像相同，配额分别28/28/28/2/6与18/18/18/3/9；短C份额37.5494%与20.4888%，不是同人口拓扑消融。
1K三短画像来自序列外推，NQL384还使用NQL插值。无额外C缩放不代表1K值来自原始直接测量行。
V38三种较短画像中64K/NQL512属于SL，不可把三者全部标作SS；严格SS补充另给32K128、48K256、64K128。
请求数份额与C时间份额均按完整冻结人口计算；不等于任一1秒执行窗口内的画像时间构成。
mean rho以每卡完整纯计算时间为需求归一化基准，是必要平均容量检查，不保证局部突发和截止期。
全体请求t=0同时进入系统队列，不表示它们全部t=0获得admission。Admission SLO不含接纳前等待。
Baseline/Once/New Once为原NPU固定绑定；S1/S2/S3 pipeline会重分卡，输入表每卡配额指原始输入NPU。

verification.manifest_recomputed_by: notes/aggregate_mixed_profiles.py:audit_manifest; rerun on every selected frozen manifest
verification.input_crosschecks: fingerprint; every exact 176KiB placement block; data direct rows; per-ID original C/V; all t0; no padding; entire-list shuffle replay; per-lane quotas; independent capacity matrix
verification.result_crosschecks: prior full-event audit JSON plus final profiles/windows/runs CSV; sum complete profile SLO integer counts; verify result file SHA256 and each core source SHA256; all 48 windows all-active
